rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin; a box is the screen bounding box of its 8 projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]
rules.frog: a spot is the ground (or seat, or step) under his feet: q.x = round(sx) - 16, q.y = round(sy) - 25; q.s = the spot's scale
rules.abuela: standing: a spot is the ground under her feet: ab.x = round(sx), ab.y = round(sy) + 1 (balcon.js:123 draws her at ab.x - 30, ab.y - 50). Sitting: points.ABS.screen is the sprite's top left
rules.table: a glass or jug on the table stands with its bottom on MESA_Y at the x of a mesa.* point (all on one row, a little in front of the table's middle, each base inside the top)
rules.relative: what the old code draws relative to a character, a glass, ABS or the frog (offsets like ABS[0]+31, v.x+lado*19, b.x+b.w+1) keeps its offsets
rules.sky: screen-space effects keep their old numbers: the red flash (W.rojo), the bird coming in from SW+12, 30, the stars of marcador and fin
rules.view: a view has a zoom; here all three are zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window with x0 = clamp(round(sx - 98), 0, 44), sx the projection of its world point. Never a fraction
rules.viewChange: between two zoom 1 views the window slides (camGo, whole pixels)
rules.pair: a review or level picture is pictures[word.side] (level: level[...].picture): zoom 1 = the 196 x 104 window [clamp(round(sx - 98), 0, 44), clamp(round(sy - 52), 0, 112)]; zoom 2 = the 98 x 52 region [clamp(round(sx - 49), 0, 142), clamp(round(sy - 26), 0, 164)] shown nearest-neighbour at 2 x 2 in the 196 x 104 picture. crop is given. The old rectangles (remap cam and crop) say which pictures they were
rules.walk: abCamina walks abuela in a straight screen line between her spots, as before, now between the new spots
